scientific_question: With exactly five cumulative MACE trainings, matched initial labels, matched final label budget, matched seeds, and no intermediate test access, does a validation-conditioned RSI policy improve final independent rMD17 error or convergence relative to static, manual, and diagnostic-removed controls?

source_dataset.name: revised MD17 (rMD17)
source_dataset.scope_boundary: A fast molecular-potential loop benchmark. It is not a MOF or adsorption-energy result.

five_round_data_protocol.selection_information: Atomic numbers and coordinates only. Unqueried energy and force labels are never admissible selection inputs.
five_round_data_protocol.training_semantics: Each stage retrains the same recipe from scratch on its cumulative selected labels. Checkpoint warm-starting is intentionally not used in v1.

scientific_environment.runtime_boundary: Do not launch CPU or GPU training concurrently with the active formal MOF MACE campaign without a fresh shared-resource check.

validation_residual_diagnostic.information_policy: Only validation receipts and prior validation receipts are admissible. This classifier provides an operational sampling hypothesis, not a physical causal diagnosis.

equal_budget_invariants: same molecule, source partition, initial 128 labels, validation set, seed, MACE recipe, and five cumulative label totals
same four acquisition opportunities of 64 labels and final 384-label budget
same independent evaluator and test-release barrier
no automatic retry, replacement, or selective early stopping
four_arm_research_loop.test_release: For a policy-holdout seed, test evaluation begins only after all four arms have closed round 5 training and validation receipts.
four_arm_research_loop.failure_policy: A failed stage closes the campaign as FAILED_NO_AUTO_RETRY; it may not be silently rerun or replaced.

five_axes.design: A 2^(5-1) resolution-V screening registry uses generator Model = Prompt × Data × Tool × Workflow. Main effects are not aliased with two-factor interactions; the 16-cell registry is executed only after every level passes its admission gate.

prompt.high: structured residual-mechanism wording with evidence and non-causal interpretation boundary

data.high: label-blind random-or-geometry coverage acquisition with provenance

tool.high: registered validation_residual_v1 diagnostic; outer-generated compositions must pass a separate typed interface gate

workflow.high: five-stage conditional policy using only registered validation residuals

model.high: pinned foundation adaptation; not runnable until a foundation artifact, model hash, and matching micro recipe are admitted

five_axes.interpretation: The current five-round implementation admits the scratch block and the Prompt/Data/Tool/Workflow contrasts. The complete 16-cell five-axis screen is explicitly blocked rather than fabricated until the model-high level is reproducible.

primary: final independent test force component MAE
validation learning curve across all five rounds
analysis_contract.pairing: Molecule × seed × initial label set is the paired unit. Methods are not independent replicates.
analysis_contract.claim_boundary: A completed scratch block supports a benchmark and control-mechanism conclusion only. It does not establish MOF adsorption accuracy or a general physical cause of an error pattern.

episode: one training receipt and validation receipt per round
